address_spaces.name: cached
address_spaces.notes: The cached xkphys base, with no attribute; the same value as the Origin 200.

address_spaces.name: Hub special
address_spaces.notes: Attribute 0, as on the Origin 200. Split on IP35 into a 128 MB local register window at 0x1000_0000 and a 128 MB boot window at 0x1800_0000, with remote forms at 0x3000_0000 and 0x3800_0000. The L1 UART is inside the register window. The OpenBSD board-identification read remains an unresolved consumer requirement.

address_spaces.name: I/O
address_spaces.notes: 16 MB small windows at widget times 16 MB; 512 MB big windows in M mode at (entry plus one) times 512 MB, selected by seven translation entries; the Bedrock's own registers are widget 1 of the node.

address_spaces.name: uncached memory
address_spaces.notes: Attribute 3. The node number sits at physical bits 39:33 in M mode, seven bits, an 8 GB node window and 128 nodes; N mode halves the window and is out of scope.

machine.name: Onyx 3400
machine.notes: The Figure 1-10 brick set: four two-processor C-bricks, an I-brick, an N-brick and two G-bricks of two InfiniteReality3 pipes each, one pipe per C-brick. C-brick 0 cables to I-brick port A and the I-brick's port B to pipe 0 of G-brick 0. C-bricks 1 to 3 cable to N-brick connectors C-brick 0 to 2, and N-brick Graphics pipe 0 to 2 to pipe 1 of G-brick 0 and pipes 0 and 1 of G-brick 1. Each cable's end connectors are documented; which C-brick, connector pair and pipe a real system pairs is not, so the pairing is this composition's choice. The Ktown2-to-I/O-brick hop is described by the shared XIO bus, not an xio_cables record, because a cable end on a board is not yet a catalogue end kind. The two R-bricks and every NUMAlink cable are left out: which router ports a C-brick uses is unknown, so the C-bricks' LINK connectors share one placeholder bus and no C-brick Bedrock is on a fabric here. Processor clock, cache and memory are not asserted. The C-, I-, N- and G-brick layers carry no L1, so no controller is described, and the composition never compiles.
